## 🎯 Objective
Implement Page Object Model design pattern with BasePage abstract class and TextBoxPage implementation using PageFactory for improved test maintainability and code reusability.
---

## 📋 Tasks
- [ ] Create `BasePage.java` abstract class in base package
- [ ] Create `TextBoxPage.java` in pages package using PageFactory
- [ ] Update `TextBoxTest.java` to use Page Object Model
- [ ] Implement JavaScript click fallback for ad interference handling
- [ ] Enhance browser configurations with cross-browser ad-blocking
- [ ] Verify backward compatibility with existing tests
- [ ] Test cross-browser functionality

---

## 🔧 Technical Details

### Page Object Model Architecture
```java
BasePage (Abstract)
├── WebDriver, WebDriverWait, JavascriptExecutor
├── clickElement() with JavaScript fallback
├── sendKeysToElement() with proper waiting
├── wait utilities and navigation methods
└── Comprehensive logging integration

TextBoxPage (Concrete)
├── @FindBy annotations for element location
├── Form interaction methods (enterFullName, enterEmail, etc.)
├── Validation methods (verifyOutputName, etc.)
└── Business logic methods (fillForm, validateFormSubmission)
```

### Enhanced Browser Configuration
- All Browsers: Ad-blocking and performance optimizations
- JavaScript Fallback: Robust click handling for element interference
- Cross-browser Consistency: Similar optimizations across Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- BasePage abstract class provides common utilities for all page objects
- TextBoxPage successfully implements PageFactory pattern
- Existing TextBoxTest works with new Page Object Model
- JavaScript click fallback handles ad interference
- Cross-browser compatibility maintained
- All existing tests pass successfully
- CI/CD pipeline remains stable
